Louis Armstrong:
What a Wonderful World

Thursday, October 1st | 6PM
The Jazz Legacy Project and Michael Cruse present Louis Armstrong: What a Wonderful World. The father of American popular music as we know it, Louis Armstrong created the language and style inherent in all American music, finding his way into 6 generations of hits such as "Hello Dolly", "When the Saints go Marching In", and What a Wonderful World". Trumpeter and singer Michael Cruse performs regularly at the Louis Armstrong House in Queens, as well at the LIncoln Center, bringing the spirit of "Satchmo" alive.

Vinyl Velocity

Saturday, May 30th, 2026 | 7:00 PM
Vinyl Velocity takes you on a full-throttle ride through the greatest hits from the 60's, 70's, and 80's. From the punchy horns of Chicago, to the glam rock of Foreigner, this show takes you back to the best moments of the vinyl record era. Created by frontman Drew Pournelle, Vinyl Velocity gets audiences singing along to all their favorite hits from "Drift Away" and "Hold the Line" to "Joy to the World" and "25 or 6 to 4". From the king of Rock'n'Roll to the Eagles, Toto, and Journey, these are timeless songs that defined a generation.
Tickets

Always Celine

Sunday, August 16th, 2026 | 6:00 PM
A captivating 90-minute tribute show featuring the remarkable vocal talent of Lakieta, whose rich tones and dynamic range beautifully echo the essence of Celine Dion. With heartfelt emotion and precision, Lakieta, along with her live band, delivers Celine’s biggest hits, including beloved classics like "My Heart Will Go On," "The Power of Love," and "Because You Loved Me." Also featuring some of Celine’s iconic cover songs, offering a powerful blend of emotional ballads and uplifting anthems, audiences will be immersed in the artistry and passion that have made Celine’s music legendary. Always Celine is more than a tribute—it’s a celebration of the timeless music and enduring spirit of one of the world’s greatest artists. Perfect for fans of all ages, it promises an unforgettable experience filled with music, emotion, and inspiration.
